title: Chat
deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.

emptyState.title: Ask anything about your inbox
emptyState.hint: Try "summarise unread emails from this week" or "draft a reply to my last message from {{sender}}".
emptyState.askToStart: Ask a question about your emails to get started.
emptyState.askThreadToStart: Ask a question about this email thread to get started.

input.placeholderEmails: Ask about your emails… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)

noAccount: Select an account to start chatting with your emails.

today.label: Today's summary
today.prompt: Summarise the emails I've received today. Format it as a markdown table with the columns | Sender | Subject | Time | Urgency | Summary |, sorted by urgency. Cite each email with its reference number. End with a short paragraph highlighting the most important things of the day.

pending.label: To-dos
pending.prompt: Identify the emails that need my reply or action. Present them in a markdown table with the columns | Sender | Subject | What they ask | Deadline | Priority |, sorted by priority (high → low). Include the relevant citations. Close with a short, friendly recommendation on where to start.

thisWeek.label: This week
thisWeek.prompt: Summarise the most important emails of this week. Use a markdown table with the columns | Day | Sender | Subject | Topic | Suggested action |, sorted chronologically. Cite each entry. End with two or three sentences on the week's dominant topics.

unread.label: Unread
unread.prompt: Show me the most relevant unread emails. Format: a markdown table with the columns | Sender | Subject | Category | Why it matters | Urgency |. Sort by descending urgency and include the citations. Close with a short, polite suggestion on which ones are worth opening first.

clients.label: Clients
clients.prompt: Review recent client emails and flag the ones that need attention. Use a markdown table with the columns | Client | Subject | Type (enquiry / complaint / opportunity) | What they expect from me | Urgency |, sorted by urgency. Cite each row. End with a short tip on the next step for each key client.

message.wrongPlaceholder: e.g. those emails are from September, not August

research.writing: Research: writing the report from {{total}} emails…

intro.title: Chat with your emails
intro.body: Ask questions in natural language. The assistant retrieves the most relevant emails and grounds its answer in them, with clickable citations.
intro.retrievalRestricted: Retrieval is restricted to {{categories}}. Change the selection in the chat input dropdown.

panel.title: Chat
panel.emptyHint: Ask about the email you have open, anything in your inbox, or how to do something in EmailOps.

context.remove: Don't use this thread as context
context.restore: Use the open thread as context
context.hint: Answers are grounded in this thread only. Remove it to search your whole inbox.

otherAccount.label: This email is in {{email}}
otherAccount.hint: Chat is answering from a different account, so it can't read this email. Switch to ask about it.

unifiedScopeHint: In All accounts view, chat searches {{email}} only

accountPicker.label: Account this chat searches
accountPicker.hint: Chat answers from one account at a time. Switching starts a new conversation.

research.title: Research mode: reads many more emails in batches and writes a detailed analysis. Slower — can take several minutes. Applies to the next message only.
